evidence.quote: what risks are associated with it
Existing research publications highlight some potential vulnerabilities that can exist in AI Models which could result in personal data being processed
what must be demonstrated by a data controller where personal data processing is claimed not to occur?
how can it be demonstrated that the AI Model does not process personal data?
the IE SA has received a number of complaints both from data subjects in Ireland and from data subjects throughout the EEA, by way of referrals from other SAs
the general regulation of processing taking place across the EU/EEA in this field by all supervisory authorities

an increasing number of data controllers are incorporating the use of AI Models within their business operations. This gives rise to the need for supervisory authorities to engage generally in the regulation

implementation_notes: This is a request by the Irish SA to the EDPB for an Article 64(2) GDPR opinion on AI model data processing questions. It is not itself a binding decision or guidance document; it poses questions for EDPB harmonisation. Explicitly limited to GDPR/LED application only, excluding the AI Act, DMA, DGA, DSA interplay.
